title: Penthouse August 1993 Leslie Nielsen Kailina Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, August 1993, original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet: Kailina.

Cover features: Leslie Nielsen's weird confessions ("The Naked Truth" cover with Nielsen); Special Report: women who batter men; Dangerous Liaison - a beauty queen's passion turns to poison; Vinny Paz's miracle comeback; The Post Office's $2 billion rip-off.

Back cover: Benson & Hedges cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
